notes.title: Official Release
notes.notes: [p]Hello, everyone playing Tanpopo Planet. [/p][p]Thank you very much to everyone who is interested in our game.[/p][p]This is Mareffy, the creator.[/p][p]This game has been officially released.[/p][p]We plan to continue updating the game as we see fit.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support.[/p][p]Update Details[/p][p]・Added voice acting throughout the game.[/p][p]Cast[/p][p]Nerf and others: Togano Shuu[/p][p]Shou and others: COEIROINK: Tsukuyomi-chan  [/p][p]Doo and others: COEIROINK: Kuro Satoshi Utsuki  [/p][p]Bora: COEIROINK: Merciful=Martha  [/p][p]• Added a few new illustrations (still images)  [/p][p]• Adjusted the fortune-telling feature so it can be viewed outside the game  [/p][p]• Adjusted some text and added short text in various places[/p][p]• Made the Nars doll an item starting from the second one[/p][p]• Adjusted the specifications of the juices provided by the juice shop[/p][p]• Made minor adjustments to the BGM[/p][p]• Added an image song[/p][p]• Changed the frame[/p][p]• Made Mac-compatible[/p][p]• Fixed bugs[/p][p]• Adjusted some end sequences and other elements[/p][p]• Made minor adjustments to UI, sound effects, and the placement of falling objects, etc.[/p]

notes.title: Updated to Early Access version 1.85
notes.notes:
Fixed some standing pictures and stills of some characters.
Fixed some typos.
Fixed some sentences.
Fixed minor bugs.
Voice has been made easier to hear (no longer overlaps the previous voice when repeatedly hitting text).
The game icon has been changed to a gynian.
Partial voices have been added to some events and characters.
CAST
Lumin 　Kouki Kanzaki
Tyty 　YUKA KIRISHIMA

notes.title: Updated to Early Access version 1.75
notes.notes:
Six new endings have been added.
Added main character “Lumin
Added a special event for each character
Added one more star for travel destinations.
Renewed some characters' standing pictures and backgrounds.
Fixed some stills.
Added some events with additional effects.
BGM has been added.
Added skip button during some events
Fixed some minor bugs.

notes.title: Bug fixes.
notes.notes:
Minor bugs have been fixed.
An animation now appears momentarily when something falls on the roadside

notes.title: Updated to Early Access version 1.7
notes.notes:
Adjusted the color of the background.
Some UI buttons have been made easier to recognize.
Special events for each character now have a part-voice.
Special events for each character have been adjusted.
Walking outside has decreased my energy for action.
More places to walk on the planet Pipisera (sometimes something falls down).
Added Nodori star to the destination stars.
Two items have been added.
Fixed some minor bugs.
Adjusted the difficulty level of festival mini-games.

notes.title: Dandelion Planet Early Access Version 1.5 has been updated!
notes.notes:
Dandelion Planet Early Access Version 1.5 has been updated!

Update Contents
[list]
[*] Gender selection for siblings was added.
[*] You can now spend 30 days.
[*] Added two new EDs.
[*] "Astronomical Observation" and "Festival Day" special events have been added.
[*] The back side of the main room can now be examined.
[*] Revised screen design.
[*] Fixed bugs.
[*] The display mode can now be switched on the title screen.
[/list]


Apology:
Due to lack of skill of the author,
If you return to the title without a day having passed after saving, the previous name will remain,
In fact, it is overwritten by the new saved data and you can load it again.
This will be fixed in the future, depending on the author's skills.
